en: Appointments live in a calendar. To-dos live in a task list. Keep them in one place each, not scattered across notes, phone, and memory.
The goal is not the perfect tool. The goal is that you trust one system enough to stop holding it all in your head.
Paper notes get lost; the system replaces them. If a thought is important, it goes into the system, not onto a loose scrap.
Open your calendar and task list. Put in the appointments you already know and the tasks you can name right now. No form needed — just do it.
Use the calendar and list every day this week.
When something new comes up, put it in the system immediately instead of trusting you'll remember.
What is likely to get in the way this week, and what will you do when it happens?
